response.sql: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT brokrepstat AS status, AVG(modelconf) AS avg_model_confidence FROM compliancecase GROUP BY brokrepstat), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_model_confidence) AS value FROM status_averages), qualifying AS (SELECT s.status, s.avg_model_confidence FROM status_averages AS s CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE s.avg_model_confidence > b.value), qualifying_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_model_confidence) AS value FROM qualifying) SELECT q.status, q.avg_model_confidence, q.avg_model_confidence - b.value AS above_baseline, q.avg_model_confidence / m.value AS ratio_to_qualifying_mean FROM qualifying AS q CROSS JOIN baseline AS b CROSS JOIN qualifying_mean AS m WHERE b.value IS NOT NULL AND m.value IS NOT NULL
